instruction: Soak the chillies in the vinegar for an hour.
Grind everything to a smooth paste; jar and label it.
Roast the grated coconut and spices until brown.
Fry the onions, add the roast and grind with water.
Grind everything to a bright green paste; keep it chilled.
Dissolve the sugar in 500 ml of hot water; cool and bottle.
Zest and juice the limes; stir into warm syrup and bottle.
Stir equal parts in a jug; bottle, label and chill.
Slit the kingfish and stuff it with the masala.
Shallow fry until crisp; serve with red rice.
Fry the onions; add the chilli and tamarind.
Add coconut milk and prawns; simmer, do not boil.
Add the masala and water; simmer until tender.
